ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (1) at Sparkling's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (2) within thirty (30) calendar days of such expiry or termination, return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (3) thereafter delete Sparkling's data from its systems and certify such deletion to Sparkling in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a reciprocal exit provision: Section 17(b) already requires us to return or destroy Garman's materials, but nothing requires Garman to return our data or help us transition. Our playbook requires up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of our data in machine-readable form within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter; we can work with 90 days of assistance if that is easier for Garman to resource.
input.summary: Insert Section 17(d) requiring Garman to provide transition assistance and return/delete Sparkling's data on termination.
